newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Zambia Consolidated sets $50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Zambia Consolidated sets $50 mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, March 14 (LPC) - Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd has mandated Kredietbank to arrange a $50 million trade finance facility which will be used to purchase mining equipment, the bank announced.
The loan is backed by the export receipts of copper contracts under existing supply agreements.
Funds will be used to support Zambia Consolidated Copper during a privatisation programme now in progress, Kredietbank said.
The loan, which matures on December 31, 1997, begins to amortise in July.
